name: s1_live_hull
prompt: Edit this reference-only repeated sprite canvas into EXACTLY EIGHT horizontal frames of an IDLE/RUNNING tank HULL module. SAME live Bullets of Fury authored tank, not an old tank design. Every hull MUST match this source precisely: moss-green rectangular armored body, its two grey tread tracks, central EMPTY round turret socket, orange rear vent lights and small orange ports, matching camo, vents and green highlights. This is ONLY the HULL: never add a gun, turret, soldier, shadow, exhaust cloud or any new parts. Top down, nose and tracks point DOWN as in reference. NO body rotation, NO banking. A subtle seamless eight-frame loop ONLY changes tread links advancing down one link per frame and the orange engine vents breathing slightly. Everything else identical and fixed to the same center and identical size in each cell. No red flashing damage state. EIGHT equally spaced cells in one horizontal row, generous transparent margins separating all hulls, exactly eight, no labels/grid. Crisp richly shaded arcade pixel art at this reference density, not smooth painting. Real transparent RGBA background, clean outlines with no halo. First and last pose lead into each other. Preserve empty turret socket so the independently aiming turret overlays the original pivot. Do not redesign this tank.

name: s1_live_turret
prompt: Produce exactly FOUR horizontal firing/recoil animation frames of ONLY this independently rotating tank TURRET module from Bullets of Fury. Preserve the exact moss-green armored circular turret, orange vent details, camo, vines, center hatch and the TWO long parallel cannon barrels pointing straight DOWN. One turret, exactly TWO barrels in every frame. No hull, no tracks, no extra weapons. Keep the original turret center/pivot, same silhouette, same size, same lighting and body orientation in all four equal cells. Frame1: left barrel emits a small sharp orange/yellow muzzle flash at its tip, barrels otherwise reference position. Frame2: right barrel flashes, both barrels retract toward turret by 3 native pixels, flash only at existing barrel tips. Frame3: no flash, barrels halfway returned. Frame4: exact resting reference with both barrels fully extended, no flash. Only barrels recoil inside their mounts, turret armor never moves or rotates. A controlled compact flash, no broad glow, no black backdrop, no added shadow, real transparent RGBA. Match this authored richly shaded pixel art precisely, no generic replacement. FOUR complete isolated turrets arranged in ONE horizontal row, not two rows, generous equal transparent cells and no labels. The head-shaped turret hatch remains the same and never develops a face. Count four modules and eight total barrels.

name: s1_buggy_idle

The roof rockets remain perfectly still and RED in all frames, NO firing/flash/projectile. Wheels and axles remain attached, roof details all intact. Eight equal transparent cells in ONE horizontal strip, same fixed center and scale, generous separation, no text/labels/grid. This must be a near exact preservation of the source pixel-art design, no sci-fi redesign, no new gun barrel, no added tank treads or extra wheel. Crisp detailed 16-bit arcade pixels matching reference. Fully transparent RGBA, no scenery or ground shadow, no halo. Smooth seamless 8-frame loop returning to first, motion in wheels only.

name: s1_buggy_fire
prompt: Take this exact Bullets of Fury rocket buggy design and produce EXACTLY FOUR horizontal fire animation frames, not eight. Same source: tan camouflaged wheeled truck, two blue windshield windows, eight RED roof-mounted rocket tips, nose facing DOWN, four wheels, same fixed center/scale. Frame1: one of the front rack tubes releases a compact orange-yellow ignition flare downward at its existing tube end. Frame2: flash contracts with a short orange exhaust wisp, rack recoils upward only 2 native pixels. Frame3: no flash, rack settles back. Frame4: original resting pose. The actual flying missile is supplied separately by the engine, so NO detached/flying missile should be drawn on this sheet. All eight red tips keep their authored red hue, no palette changes. No body rotation, no suspension displacement, no new barrel or extra rack, no scenery, no shadow, no labels, no grid. FOUR isolated complete vehicles in four equal cells in one horizontal row with generous transparent margins. Crisp detailed 16-bit arcade sprite finish exactly matching the reference. True transparent RGBA and clean edges with no halo.

name: s1_wake
prompt: Generate a production sprite sheet of EXACTLY EIGHT sequential WATER WAKE animation frames for top-down 16-bit Bullets of Fury navy boats. Only the moving wake effect; NO boat, NO vehicle, NO island, NO background or solid water tile. One horizontal strip, eight equally sized and spaced transparent cells. A long narrow boat-shaped EMPTY TRANSPARENT center, where a boat will be rendered independently. The boat travels nose DOWN. Fine cool cyan ripples and very pale blue/white foam peel away around two sides of the transparent boat footprint, with a small V-shaped stern wake above; subtle little bow ripples below. Keep the same footprint/center in every cell. The foam ripples advance up and outward over frames1-8 with smooth breakup into small crisp droplets, last returning seamlessly to first. Small readable restrained arcade wake, no huge glowing ring, no opaque pool or shadow, no blur, no circular blast/explosion. Pixel-art 16-bit/NeoGeo appearance with hand-shaded pixels. Transparent black areas remain actual RGBA transparency, no black fill or checkerboard, no text or grid. Exactly eight complete wake effects.

name: s1_exhaust
prompt: Create EXACTLY EIGHT horizontal sprite animation frames of a compact BLUE jet-engine EXHAUST flame for the current Bullets of Fury top-down aircraft. Effect ONLY, no aircraft/metal nozzle or spaceship, no circle, no background. The flame nozzle connection is at the BOTTOM CENTER of each equal cell and the flame points straight UP. Cool blue/cyan sharply shaded flame with a small brilliant white-blue core near the nozzle, tapered electric-blue tips, clean pixel-art edges. A smooth repeating eight-frame idle engine burn: short compact flame, longer divided tip, flicker, medium flame, longest split tip, shorten, shorter, original compact. Small jets of white/cyan exhaust pixels, not soft particle haze, no broad aura. Flame base anchored at exactly same location every frame, tip alone changes length. One horizontal row of eight separated complete effects, generous real RGBA transparent margins. No labels/grid/ground shadow, no purple/red/orange recolor. Detailed 16-bit arcade pixels to overlay existing approved aircraft intact; do not draw an aircraft. Count eight flame effects. Final frame connects smoothly to frame1.

name: s1_muzzles
prompt: Create a production Bullets of Fury 16-bit arcade muzzle-effect sprite strip, EXACTLY EIGHT horizontal equal cells. Effect ONLY, no vehicles/weapons/background. First FOUR cells are a four-frame compact kinetic cannon muzzle FLASH (yellow-white hot core, amber/orange petals and tiny warm sparks); last FOUR cells are a four-frame compact rocket launcher ignition/exhaust FLASH (white-yellow core, orange-red tapered ignition). Point straight DOWN in all cells. No purple halo, no aura/ring, no huge explosion. Frame1 each set: bright initial compact flare attached at TOP CENTER pivot; frame2: slightly elongated/downward peak with angular little petals; frame3: smaller residual flame; frame4: tiny dying sparks. Top anchor remains fixed; all expansion goes downward. Clean highly shaded pixel art with 1-2 pixel angular clusters, matching NeoGeo sprite effects. Real fully transparent RGBA with generous margins, no black fill or checkerboard. Exactly eight isolated effects in one horizontal row (FOUR kinetic + FOUR rocket), no labels/grid or detached projectile/rocket/bullet. Existing authored projectiles stay unchanged in the engine; these are only their firing flash.
